hypothesis: A source-exact conditions value with an unrelated evidence quote can be recovered from one unique full-line source span, keeping leading list markers and punctuation.
scope: Conditions field only. Do not modify models, prompts or QA validation.
rejection_rules: Changed characters, repeated matching occurrences, missing leading qualifiers, and omitted substantive trailing text must not be accepted by source-span recovery.
Keep the existing fallback when recovery is unavailable.
checks: Paired replay of all five actual public-v11 extraction generations.
Targeted synthetic adversarial cases for negation, numbers, repeated text and source boundaries.
Isolated real five-page image API run before deployment.
limits: Existing development documents, not unseen evaluation or independent human review.
Source matching does not establish semantic correctness or OCR fidelity.
No new training or use of reserved test data.
